title: COMMS LAB 1/5 — a verifier who must interrogate the author
desc: Build 'chatcode verify <task-id>': it picks a second reviewer who did not touch the task, chooses ONE claim from the report, and files it as a single question on #task-<id> BEFORE reading the code. The verdict file (board/<id>.verify.json) must cite the answer's message id and say whether the answer changed the verdict. Two agents are structurally required: the author holds context the verifier cannot obtain alone. Solo version impossible by design.
